name: warrant-mcp
description: Policy firewall for AI agent tool calls — plain-English rules compiled once, enforced by deterministic code.

plugins.name: warrant-policy-author
plugins.description: Writes warrant-mcp policies in plain English that compile on the first attempt: a short interview, sentences shaped for the closed rule set, and the failure shapes explained rather than avoided. The skill writes policy text only — enforcement is warrant-mcp's PreToolUse hook and deterministic engine, wired per-project by `warrant-mcp init`, never by this plugin.
